decisions.text: Pages 1-8 and 10: images generated with Higgsfield model gpt_image_2_6 (quality high, PNG) through the connected Higgsfield account. Page 9 (Request 5, 2026-11-12): images generated with the Higgsfield API, Marketing Studio Image 2.5 Flare (marketing-studio/image/flare, quality high, 2k, enhance_prompt false), using the canonical character sheets and the layout PNG as ordered references. Character sheets and panels are text-free; lettering is composited by the shared CLI.
decisions.reason: User instruction on 2026-11-10 ('sure') approving Higgsfield; on 2026-11-12 the connected account had 1.25 credits, the user supplied an API key with an API balance ('i’ve $10 + in hf api'), and gpt_image_2_6 is not offered through the API, so Flare (GPT Image 2.5 based) is the closest available model.
